tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The connected sitectrl account: email, plan status, free-site slot, and credit balance.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the user's sitectrl sites with their live URLs and hosting platform.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Details for one site: live URL, draft URL, status.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Build a brand-new hosted website from a plain-language description. RETURNS IMMEDIATELY with status 'building' — the site takes about 2-3 minutes and is NOT ready when this returns. Tell the user where it will be (expected_url) and poll get_build_status with the returned claim_token. NEVER call crea

tools.name: get_build_status
tools.description: Check whether a site started by create_site has finished. Pass the claim_token create_site returned. Works WITHOUT signing in. Poll this every 30-60 seconds rather than calling create_site again — a second create_site call builds a SECOND site.

tools.name: edit_site
tools.description: Ask sitectrl's AI editor to change an existing site ('add a contact page', 'make the hero darker'). Edits land in the site's draft; the first build of a brand-new site goes straight live. Returns what changed plus the draft URL.

tools.name: write_site_files
tools.description: Push files (HTML/CSS/JS/images) into a site's DRAFT — use this when YOU are writing the code yourself instead of asking sitectrl's AI. Text files go in 'content'; binary files (images/fonts) in 'content_base64'. Max 40 files/call, 2 MB/file. Keep the <script defer src="sc-track.js"></script> include

tools.name: list_site_files
tools.description: List the files in a site's draft tree (paths + sizes).

tools.name: read_site_file
tools.description: Read one file from a site's draft tree (text, or base64 for binary; 512 KB cap).

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Publish the site's draft to the LIVE site (hosted sites). A snapshot of the previous live version is taken first, so it's undoable.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Search real domain availability + prices (com/net/org/co/io/site and more). Available results include a purchase_url — hand it to the USER to complete checkout; the connector never spends money. Purchased domains connect to their sites in one click.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: The site's private first-party traffic: pageviews/visitors/sessions/clicks totals, top pages, referrers, devices. Windows: 24h, 7d, 30d.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_site" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Build a brand-new hosted website from a plain-language description. RETURNS IMMEDIATELY with status 'building' — the site takes about 2-3 minutes and is NOT rea…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_sites, get_site · Private data: edit_site, write_site_files, list_site_files, read_site_file, get_analytics · Public sink: whoami, write_site_files, publish_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_sites, get_site · Private data: edit_site, write_site_files, list_site_files, read_site_file, get_analytics · Public sink: whoami, write_site_files, publish_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
